notes:
Fixes the Release Notes dialog OK button so it is visually centered and reliably closes the window when clicked.

Adds a proper onClick handler while keeping keyboard and back navigation fallbacks.

Improves site artwork compatibility by assigning the site thumbnail to thumb, icon, poster, fanart and landscape artwork for Adult-TV-Channels.com, Adult-TV-Channels.click and FuckFlix.click.

This improves compatibility with Arctic: Zephyr 2 - Resurrection Landscape Wall and other skin views that prefer landscape or fanart artwork.

Keeps the working Custom Site thumbnail repair from v1.83 unchanged.

Streaming logic is unchanged from v1.77-v1.83.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
